PolicyNote: Certification evidence must come from the airframe, independently witnessed. Rig data is not accepted by the authority.
Timing and power figures measured in software are estimates. Performance is verified on the rig or not at all.
Safety requirements are verified on hardware and by someone other than the author. Both halves are the rule; either alone has failed before.
Interfaces must be exercised against real neighbours. A unit test proves the author's intent, not the behaviour.
An interface is verified when both sides run together. A mock agrees with whatever it was written to agree with.
